_note: Rules for the conflicts pilot (v2 contract). 'windows' says which timeline a headline start belongs to (astronomical years). 'withhold_undated_nonprincipal' (default true): a war strip is built only for the first entry of each side and for entries that have a joining year of their own; set false to give every other entry the war's whole span. 'wide_row' is the top-level row for a multi-region war. 'importance': the first matching rule sets 1 (key); casualties are not read in the pilot, so importance comes from the ranking (main combatant and inlinks): 'inlinks' >= N sets 1.
